name: CIS Benchmarks
description: Center for Internet Security prescriptive configuration guidelines for hardening cloud identities, storage, networking, and compute.

requirements.title: Maintain Root/Admin Account Access Restrictions & MFA
requirements.mitigation: Hardware token MFA and root API key deletion

requirements.title: Ensure All Object Storage Has Public Access Blocked
requirements.mitigation: Bucket-level public block and uniform access

requirements.title: Ensure Multi-Zone Network Isolation with Zero 0.0.0.0/0 Ingress
requirements.mitigation: Strict stateful firewall security group rules

requirements.title: Mandate Envelope KMS Encryption with Customer Keys
requirements.mitigation: AES-256 automated key rotation and HSM backing

requirements.title: Enforce Continuous Audit Logging & Real-Time SIEM Streaming
requirements.mitigation: Immutable multi-region audit event collection

name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5
description: Security and Privacy Controls for Federal Information Systems and Organizations under FISMA / FedRAMP.

requirements.title: Account Management & Least Privilege
requirements.mitigation: Ephemeral workload identity and role-based credential issuance

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement
requirements.mitigation: Private network boundaries, VPC peering policies, and microsegmentation

requirements.title: Event Logging & Tamper-Resistant Storage
requirements.mitigation: WORM retention logs, cryptographic digest hashing, and SIEM forwarding

requirements.title: Boundary Protection & Network Firewalls
requirements.mitigation: Deny-all inbound firewall policies and inspected egress proxies

requirements.title: Cryptographic Protection at Rest and in Transit
requirements.mitigation: FIPS 140-3 validated KMS keys and TLS 1.3 enforced transport

name: PCI-DSS v4.0
description: Global standard for organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data (CHD) and sensitive authentication data.

requirements.title: Restrict Traffic Between Cardholder Data Environment and Public Networks
requirements.mitigation: Strict DMZ firewall architecture and private VPC subnets

requirements.title: Render Cardholder Data Unreadable Anywhere It Is Stored
requirements.mitigation: AES-256 GCM envelope encryption with dual-custody keys

requirements.title: Public-Facing Web Applications Protected Against Attacks
requirements.mitigation: Cloud WAF with managed OWASP Core Rule Set and bot mitigation

requirements.title: Strong Multi-Factor Authentication for All System Access
requirements.mitigation: Phishing-resistant WebAuthn / FIDO2 MFA enforcement

requirements.title: Automated Audit Trails for All System Components
requirements.mitigation: Centralized immutable logging with NTP time synchronization

name: SOC 2 Type II
description: American Institute of CPAs framework evaluating Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy.

requirements.title: Logical Access Security & Identity Governance
requirements.mitigation: Automated credential deprovisioning and SSO integration

requirements.title: Boundary Defense & Network Perimeter Protection
requirements.mitigation: Stateful cloud firewalls, WAF inspection, and VPC isolation

requirements.title: Data Transmission Protection (In-Transit Encryption)
requirements.mitigation: Strict TLS 1.3 termination and mutual TLS (mTLS) service mesh

requirements.title: Vulnerability Management & Anomaly Detection
requirements.mitigation: Continuous container image scanning and runtime eBPF monitoring

requirements.title: Automated Disaster Recovery & Backup Replication
requirements.mitigation: Multi-region point-in-time recovery and snapshot replication

name: MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud
description: Globally accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) targeting cloud environments.

requirements.title: Valid Accounts: Cloud Workload Hijacking
requirements.mitigation: Ephemeral IAM tokens, conditional access policies, and session bounds

requirements.title: Data from Cloud Storage Object Stores
requirements.mitigation: Uniform Bucket Access, private ACLs, and DSPM anomaly detection

requirements.title: Escape to Host (Container Breakout)
requirements.mitigation: Pod Security Standards (Restricted profile) and gVisor sandboxing

requirements.title: Network Service Discovery & Lateral Movement
requirements.mitigation: Default-deny NetworkPolicy and VPC subnetwork microsegmentation

requirements.title: Network Denial of Service (Terabit Floods)
requirements.mitigation: Automated cloud DDoS shielding, Anycast scrubbing, and rate limiting
